test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. **

Manufacture
solution: The correct answer is "**Destroy**" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the meaning of the given word. • **Manufacture: **make (something) on a large scale using machinery. • Let's look at the meaning of the given options. • **Fabricate**: invent (something) in order to deceive. • **Produce: **make or manufacture from components or raw materials. • **Destroy: **end the existence of (something) by damaging or attacking it. • **Build: **construct (something) by putting parts or material together. • As per the meaning of the given words, "**Destroy" **is the antonym of "manufacture" • **Example**: *The car is **destroyed **__after the accident* Hence, the correct answer is** option 3.** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] __Hinglish__** • Let's look at the meaning of the given word. • **Manufacture:**मशीनरी का उपयोग करके बड़े पैमाने पर (कुछ) बनाना। • Let's look at the meaning of the given options. • **Fabricate**:आविष्कार (कुछ) धोखा देने के लिए। • **Produce:**घटकों या कच्चे माल से बनाना या निर्माण करना • **Destroy:**(किसी चीज) के अस्तित्व को समाप्त करना या उस पर हमला करना। • **Build:**भागों या सामग्री को एक साथ रखकर निर्माण (कुछ)। • As per the meaning of the given words, "**Destroy" **is the antonym of "manufacture" 83:T8e0, The correct answer is "**Perseverance**".
